link.title: Dates in Bitbybit
link.description: Work with dates and times inside a Bitbybit script - create them, read their parts, and compare or shift them by an interval. Date handling matters more than it first appears in parametric work: driving a sun-path study, stamping an export with the moment it was generated, or animating a model across a timeline. These pages cover constructing dates from components, extracting the year, month, day and time parts, and doing arithmetic on them. Each example is shown in Rete, Blockly and TypeScript.
